parent.observerProvenance: committed 306c80f03a55f70fd7d71d7311ac8396ed8325cc; controller-selected optimized observer before independent mechanism review; explicit SHA pin and source manifest freeze exact bytes

bodies.weldedDiagnosticClaim: B/C do not establish articulated three-dynamic-link contact blocking

joint.softLimit: native unilateral constraint; no qpos clamp
joint.overshootAuthority: explicit controller engineering gate before data; not the TZ anchor tolerance

motor.forceCapComparison: exact native cap; arithmetic budgets never enlarge it
motor.controlSample: native pre-step qpos/qvel; left integer native interval; raw PD ctrl written only after mj_step1
motor.off: ctrl=0; actual actuator_force and qfrc_actuator exactly0

contact.frictionlessMeaning: explicit wall-L3 pair dim1; no tangential constraints even if native contact friction padding is nonzero
contact.normalConvention: geom0_to_geom1; contact force acts on geom1

reference.status: analytic diagnostics, not measured PASS or a force-accuracy tolerance

stationary.A: last1s of each3s drive phase; all3 joints near corresponding limit within .25deg; fresh positive lambda and correctly signed restoring generalized torque every interval
stationary.B: last1s; solved loaded wall reaction, q3 below upper range, no J3 limit rows
stationary.C: last1s; upper limit loaded, positive lambda and negative restoring generalized torque, no contacts
stationary.D: entire1s; zero native actuator torque; no loaded contact or limit rows
stationary.endpoints: all pre states and every post endpoint; final endpoint state-only, no extra force solve

refinement.referenceSizeSource: L3 authored longest dimension, immutable and independent of result
refinement.eventTimestamp: first solved loaded wall (B) or upper-limit (C) at saved PRE force phase; integer intervalStartUs plus native pre.time retained
refinement.matching: same case, repetition and prescribed final model time; no interpolation

energy.mechanical: sum body COM kinetic plus rotational kinetic plus m*9.81*(z-z0), native endpoint kinematics

phase.main: mj_step1 -> save pre forward geometry/J -> sample raw PD and write ctrl -> mj_step2 -> save current constraint/actuator forces -> mj_kinematics,mj_comPos,mj_comVel -> endpoint poses
phase.initialKinematics: one state-preserving kinematics/comPos/comVel refresh per planned world, zero advances
phase.ownership: native owns qpos/qvel; JS writes ctrl only; no manual pose/velocity evolution

resources.temporaryOwnership: shared observer contact-vector/contact and warning-stat owned copies; DoubleBuffer caller owned; counters and finally; no leak-proof claim

budget.scope: one explicit main invocation; replays separately counted; no admission/probe/hidden worlds

retention.numericEncoding: IEEE754 binary64 little endian, preserve -0, canonical NaN quiet payload 0x7ff8000000000000; finite guards still fail nonfinite
retention.strings: UTF8 length-prefixed U32LE; object keys sorted by UTF8 byte order
retention.recordFraming: tagged canonical binary payload; journal header then U32LE payload bytes per record
retention.perTick: all gates and integrals on every native interval before retention; SHA256 per-tick chain; fixed100ms checkpoints; no dense trajectory arrays
retention.eventWindow: first loaded contact/limit event per world; pre/post200ms within fixed schedule only; no extra advances
retention.failureWindow: rolling ring continues after first event; independent latest pre200ms plus failing tick; reserve preserved
retention.archive: external bounded raw journal; controller arranges verified archive before publication
retention.emergencyReserveReason: one live world:800 ring ticks*(65536+1024) plus262144 failure observation plus65536 trailer; remaining reserve covers record framing
retention.failureOversizePolicy: full partial observation remains in external attempt receipt; journal retains bounded native state/counts plus full observation digest if partial exceeds256KiB; failure remains FAIL
retention.rawErrors: portable fixed classification only; complete host-specific error strings in external receipt
retention.endpointDerivedState: native COM, body/geom frames, velocities and joint anchors retained in tick evidence; no freejoint reconstruction used
retention.additionalEventRecords: full current tick for each first upper/lower reaction per joint and first loaded wall, bounded by model topology; no extra advance
retention.stageBoundaryRecords: full tick at each control phase start, each stationary window start/end, final world observation

rationale.threeLinkProof: A/D native nq=nv=3; B/C native nq=nv=1 are deliberately welded diagnostic fixtures
rationale.finiteDrive: 0.08Nm upstream cannot statically hold articulated wall load at q1=q2=0; no unbounded replacement
rationale.noKv: native fixed-gain bias-none motor; externally sampled derivative term is constant ctrl input per native step
rationale.nativeSteps: 10/20 steps per5ms macro fixed before data; no FPS adaptation
rationale.qualification: explicit frozen-source main CLI only; default tests and CLI help/plan create0 native modules/models/steps
limitations: No physical result inherited from PHY01 or cylinder admission
